designStatus: 123 no-repeat Region 5 events; rare neutral demons and recurring Infernal Broker in Hell proper.

events.label: The Last Natural Stone
events.description: The cavern still feels like the mortal world, but every tunnel descends toward something that does not.

events.label: A Red Light Below
events.description: A glow far beneath the party is not sunlight and does not flicker like an ordinary flame.

events.label: The Long Descent
events.description: Carved warnings insist the gate below was built to keep things in and travelers out.
